notes: This repo has no design-system build (Storybook or component library). The synced bundle is gym-system-design/project/ — an existing Claude Design export of the PulseFit Design System (19 Antd-derived primitives + tokens + guidelines + dashboard ui_kit) — with a hand-added 'App Components' group (StatusTag, SlotPicker, AppLayout) ported from frontend/src/components/. The converter is not used; ds-bundle/ is assembled and patched by hand. See NOTES.md.
